findings.claim: Odd-numbered continuation pages of unnumbered back-matter sections (Glossary p.57, References p.61) showed a stale "7.8. ANSWERS" running header instead of the section they're actually on.
findings.source: Root cause confirmed by reading the diff: pandoc renders headers with class "unnumbered" as starred LaTeX sections (\\section*, \\chapter*), which never call \\sectionmark/\\chaptermark, so the last numbered section's mark persisted across every later unnumbered chapter's odd pages.
findings.fix: Fixed at the shared template: book-layout.lua now inserts \\markboth{title}{title} immediately after every unnumbered level-1 header, explicitly resetting both running-head marks to that chapter's own title so every later starred section inherits it. Confirmed by direct rendering: page 9 ("About this book" continuation) now headers "About this book"; page 57 (Glossary's last content page, "Power, bases of" through "Weak ties") now headers "Glossary" instead of "7.8. ANSWERS"; page 61 (References' last page) now headers "References." No overflow or other layout regression on any checked page.

findings.claim: "...see who it serves, why they'd choose it, and what you'll do" used the ambiguous contraction "they'd," explicitly named on the style guide's banned list; identified during the first proof's research but omitted from the delivered findings by oversight.
findings.source: Style guide: avoid the ambiguous contractions there'd, it'll, they'd.
findings.fix: Fixed: now reads "why they would choose it." Confirmed rendered correctly on PDF page 49.
